vision_root_unavailable.description: A vision root's model listing cannot be used: the root or its models directory is unavailable. actingd's startup listing, its check-config and vision-provider-check refuse the root with it.

vision_models_empty.description: A vision root's model listing cannot be used: the models directory holds no model folder.

vision_model_folder_invalid.description: A vision root's model listing cannot be used: a model folder breaks the folder rule (check-config and vision-provider-check refuse it; startup records it).
